title: [BC14] Classify historical entry pages as Archive in Tell Me
summary: Five historical data pages from BC14 are now classified as Archive rather than Lists in Tell Me, moving them from the general Lists category to Reports and Analysis.
key_points: Changed UsageCategory from Lists to History on five read-only historical entry pages
Pages appear in Reports and Analysis > Archive instead of Lists in Tell Me
All page types, captions, source tables, and navigation remain unchanged
No impact on data, migration, or permissions
Supporting invoice card and subpage remain non-searchable
